rows.evidence_claim: Run listing materializes every session and full result payload for every selected run through _read_run, despite its paging limit. A 100-item page can load approximately 3.2 GiB of admitted serialized artifacts, plus substantially larger decoded Python objects, risking memory exhaustion. Frozen-source inspection and an instrumented temporary-database probe confirmed listing invokes full session decoding. Verify with multiple maximum-sized runs and assert listing does not fetch or decode their complete session payloads.

Session digest validation checks only hexadecimal syntax, never agreement with stored sessions, so incorrect integrity evidence is admitted and returned as valid. A frozen-code temporary-database probe persisted and retrieved digest cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc although the engine-defined digest of those sessions was c8c40ffb7a230e8ff90f6e719cafe44d2802cda8a8e89bb4e863f2399e5ef432. Verify admission and retrieval reject a syntactically valid digest that differs from the engine's canonical session digest.

Final balances are validated only as nonnegative integers, not reconciled with stored bankroll, wagered and paid amounts; mean_net_closed likewise receives no accounting reconciliation. Consequently materially false financial results pass fail-closed retrieval. A temporary-database probe changed final_balance to 999999 in both session copies while leaving wagered=1, paid=0 and total_net=-1 unchanged; get_reference_lab_run returned the altered balance without error. Verify coherent structural tampering is rejected using the immutable stored configuration and engine accounting identities.

Get and session-page operations issue their header and session SELECTs without an explicit read transaction. A legitimate concurrent cascade deletion between those SELECTs produces a false corruption error instead of a consistent record or missing-record result. A deterministic temporary-database interleaving reproduced ReferenceLabStoreError('stored reference-laboratory run is corrupt'). Verify both operations against a deletion interleaved between header and session reads.
